digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows for bridge reconciliation and push delivery
propositions: Inline CAS loops and raw-git exemption logic must be removed from both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows and delegated to core push entrypoints
Each workflow must invoke exactly one complete core push action (reconciler strict commit-and-push; canary strict push-only) that remains synchronous and red on exhausted failure
Reconciler bot identity, commit subject, and author fields must be preserved across the migration to the core adapter
Core retry and CAS recovery mechanisms must own collision handling; Python library and MCP retain best-effort defaults without change
Test suites must document and enforce absence of inline CAS loops, presence of single strict push step, and proper red failure disposition for rejected deliveries
